title: Shinonome Ena — Restock Time!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I should probably get on Nightcord now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, Yuki, if you can keep working on those lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Basically the same as yesterday.
I'm making adjustments to the song, Yuki's working on the lyrics and Amia the assets.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'll send the assets I'm thinking about using for this song to you a little later, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, that reminds me. You guys were busy preparing for Shibu Schools Fest over at Miya Girls again today, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. I finished doing most of the line art for the backgrounds, so we started painting them in today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I knew they'd be big, but each panel is just so massive. Painting even one takes a ton of effort.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Call it two meters, more or less?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? That's specific. How did you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The wooden panels you're using are the ones that were leaning up against the vending machines by the gym, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, now that you mention it, they were up against those vending machines during our first prep day.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Most vending machines apparently measure about 180 centimeters in height. And those panels seemed a little taller than that...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which is how you arrived on two meters.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I see. Yeah, that definitely sounds about right.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, then the panels that were brought over today were about three meters tall. They were bigger than those other ones.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <To be fair, we're making a whole town, so they sorta need to be big.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I get that...
But wow, painting all that sure must be tough on you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're welcome to come help us whenever.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, not so fast!
I'm busy as it is designing costumes with everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Don't push yourselves too hard, you two...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's okay for you both to focus on your show while I get this song more sorted.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thanks, K, but I should be fine!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Ditto.
We plan on doing a good job both here and over there.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Actually, if you need some extra hands, then why don't you have Yuki and K help?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't think I can. I'm already helping with a different show and the exhibition.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <All students who attend a high school located in Shibuya are welcome to participate, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, my teacher was the one who told me about the festival... Did your school not send any notices?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I didn't see anything when I looked through my emails the day before yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That sounds like a no to me.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You don't have to be so blunt!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I'm just telling the truth...
Each school is free to make its own decisions.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, the three of us are participating, K, so it'd be great to have you join us.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree, but I don't think there's much we can do about it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's really not much, but we could say that you played a small part in the festival, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You listened to the songs Hoshino and Tenma wrote in the diner, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, right... They said those were written specifically for the Shibu Schools Fest musical.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, you ran into them?
Did you give them any advice?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Cool! That means you're a part of the Shibu Schools Fest family now, K♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I'm thinking about going to see the show now. So many of my friends are working on it, after all.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Really?! I don't think I'll have anything to do on the day of, so I'll probably be in the audience too. Wanna see it together?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, that'd be nice.
How about you, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I probably won't be too busy. So I should be able to join you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... They're gonna need a few of the costume designers to stay backstage, but I should more or less be free.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay! Then, let's figure out a time to meet when things get closer to festival day!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Now that we know K and Yuki are coming to see the musical, we really gotta do a good job.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was sure that working on this kind of event would be exhausting and a huge pain...)
